To run the test, simply invoke your favorite test runner, or execute a test file directly; any of the following work:

    python -m unittest discover
    python test/test_download.py
    nosetests

For Python versions 3.6 and later, you can use [pynose](https://pypi.org/project/pynose/) to implement `nosetests`. The original [nose](https://pypi.org/project/nose/) has not been upgraded for 3.10 and later.

See item 6 of [new extractor tutorial](#adding-support-for-a-new-site) for how to run extractor specific test cases.

If you want to create a build of youtube-dl yourself, you'll need

* python
* make (only GNU make is supported)
* pandoc
* zip
* nosetests
interpretation: Maintainer names aggregate unittest/nose routes and separate direct-file route; following pandoc/zip list belongs to build instructions, not direct-test prerequisite proof.

def get_params(override=None):
    PARAMETERS_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                                   "parameters.json")
    LOCAL_PARAMETERS_FILE = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                                         "local_parameters.json")
    with open(PARAMETERS_FILE, encoding='utf-8') as pf:
        parameters = json.load(pf)
    if os.path.exists(LOCAL_PARAMETERS_FILE):
        with open(LOCAL_PARAMETERS_FILE, encoding='utf-8') as pf:
            parameters.update(json.load(pf))
    if override:
        parameters.update(override)
    return parameters
interpretation: Committed parameter file is merged with optional local file and explicit overrides. Source-default absence must be frozen, not presumed after config changes.
Download cases come from extractor definitions; source AST class count is not native case count.
Four optional-proxy methods return before behavior under missing-key defaults; configuring them changes proposed exclusion conditions.
Three SOCKS methods assert a string stand-in under literal True, while actual proxy setup/teardown is disabled. Passing statuses cannot prove proxy behavior.
Extractor working/test skip/additional-extractor flags can generate dynamic skips; exact prospective identities/conditions remain necessary.

# And add them to TestDownload
for n, test_case in enumerate(defs):
    tname = 'test_' + str(test_case['name'])
    i = 1
    while hasattr(TestDownload, tname):
        tname = 'test_%s_%d' % (test_case['name'], i)
        i += 1
    test_method = generator(test_case, tname)
    test_method.__name__ = str(tname)
    ie_list = test_case.get('add_ie')
    test_method.add_ie = ie_list and ','.join(ie_list)
    setattr(TestDownload, test_method.__name__, test_method)
interpretation: Dynamic method identity suffixes depend on generated extractor definitions; native full manifest must retain mappings.
Download continue-on-error affects CI policy and does not establish completed outcome.
